data_problems_found: 2005 non-detects have a reporting limit (2 mg/L as N) ten times higher than 2018 (0.2), so 21 early values are only '<2' and cannot be compared with 2018 detects
Network change: 30 wells (N00-N29) were sampled only in 2018 and have low values; pooling all 2018 rows (median 0.91) would create an apparent decline
Late results from Synthetic Lab B have no unit reported (and a different lab than 2005)
9 cohort wells have identical 2005 and 2018 values to the digit (possible copied/duplicated results)
Non-detect results have no numeric value, so pooled early median depends on a substitution convention
notes: Cohort = 30 wells (C00-C29) with both 2005 and 2018 results. No well can be shown to have declined: 21 were '<2' in 2005 and 2018 values (0.47-1.8) are all below that limit; 9 are unchanged. Pooled medians use the cohort only; early median uses non-detects at half the reporting limit (1.0; the true value is only known to be below 2), late cohort median 1.435. Using non-detects at the limit gives 2.0. The apparent decline in the pooled 2018 data (median 0.91 over all 60 wells) is driven by the added N wells.
